title: Long-Endurance Fixed-Wing Platform
description: A conventional fixed-wing UAV study using a high-aspect-ratio wing, tractor propulsion, and a clean central fuselage for efficient cruise and payload packaging. The supplied board targets a 25.76 kg MTOW and up to 100 minutes of endurance.
